name: Tracearr SSE
description: Streams playback start, progress, pause, stop, session connect and disconnect, library item added and removed, scheduled task lifecycle, and server CPU/RAM stat events as Server-Sent Events, plus a hello event carrying the plugin version. Built for Tracearr. Works with any SSE client.
overview: Real-time playback, session, library, task, and server stat events over Server-Sent Events.

versions.changelog:
- Emby dashboard thumbnail is the 16:9 catalog tile instead of the square Tracearr logo.
- Catalog art replaced: a 1920x1080 tile shared by the Jellyfin catalog and the Emby thumb, and an Emby terminal preview showing the wire format. The old images were Tracearr app placeholders.
- Both catalog manifests describe the full event set and carry per-version release notes; new releases pull them from this changelog.
Adds server.stats CPU/RAM samples every 6 seconds while a client is connected, and task.started, task.progress, and task.completed events from the scheduled task manager.
Adds library.item.added and library.item.removed events carrying itemId, itemType, and parentId.
Adds the hello event on connect, disconnects subscribers whose buffer fills so they reconnect and resync, raises the per-subscriber buffer to 512, and makes release builds report their real version.
First release: playing, progress, paused, stopped, session.start, and session.end events plus a ping keepalive every 30 seconds.
